subject: Acme procurement & security qualification \u000014 next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>, ACME Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Acme procurement & security qualification - next steps

Hi Samantha - thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so your procurement/compliance teams have what they need: 

1) Procurement path: you mentioned Acme typically purchases via PO and needs net-30 terms. Please confirm whether the PO will be sent from procurement@acme.com or from an individual approver (e.g., Oliver).

2) Security gating: procurement requires SOC 2 Type II evidence and a signed DPA before final approval. Attached are the Redwood SOC2 summary and our current DPA (Redwood_DPA_v2.pdf, SOC2_summary.pdf). If your security team prefers, we can provide the full Report under NDA or arrange a direct call.

3) Marketplace interest: you asked if Acme can buy via cloud marketplace (GCP marketplace) - short answer: yes, we support marketplace SKUs for hosted usage. If procurement prefers marketplace PO flow, let us know; that can speed PO issuance but may affect billing cadence.

4) Security questionnaire: please send the procurement/security questionnaire (or a link) and we'll have our InfoSec partner fill it out; timeline usually ~3-5 business days for the standard vendor questionnaire.

Next steps I recommend: 
- Oliver (procurement) to confirm PO sender and desired payment terms.
- Samantha to share the security questionnaire or confirm which SOC2 artifacts are sufficient.
- I'll loop in Dev for contract/terms and Aisha for escalation if needed.

I've attached a draft SOW as well to help internal scoping (SOW-draft.docx). If convenient, I can set up a short three-way with your procurement lead + our sales ops this week. 

Thanks - talk soon.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: Redwood_DPA_v2.pdf)
(Attachment: SOC2_summary.pdf)
(Attachment: SOW-draft.docx)

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: ACME Procurement <procurement@acme.com>, Oliver Chen <oliver.chen@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme procurement & security qualification - next steps

Hi Marissa - thanks for the clear recap. A few things from procurement/compliance side: 

- Procurement: Acme will purchase via PO. Oliver is the procurement owner for this engagement (cc'd). Standard process is PO + net-30 for vendor relationships. We'll confirm whether we can do marketplace for this SKU but procurement prefers native PO routing for software contracts.

- Security: Acme requires written evidence of SOC 2 Type II and a signed DPA. The SOC2_summary is helpful - procurement will likely ask for the full report under NDA. We will also send our security questionnaire to your team (attached: procurement_instructions.pdf) - the compliance group tends to route questionnaires through our vendor portal; timeline is typically 5-10 business days for review.

- Next steps: Oliver will follow up with a PO template and expected dates. I have included procurement_instructions.pdf to show our internal packet. Please let us know if you can receive an NDA for the SOC2 report.

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Head of Partnerships | Acme Corp
(Attachment: procurement_instructions.pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme procurement & security qualification - next steps

Hi Samantha - great, thanks - looping in Dev to own the PO/terms flow. A couple of notes from our side: 

- We can sign an NDA to share the full SOC 2 report; if you'd like, I can initiate the NDA via DocuSign (link below) and then share the full report with your compliance team.

- DPA: attached is our DPA v2; happy to go through redlines. We also have a DocuSign-ready copy if you prefer an electronic signature: https://www.docusign.com/da/xyz/rdw-acme-dpa

- Marketplace: we do enable GCP and AWS marketplace SKUs, but switching to marketplace can change invoicing cadence (may be monthly via marketplace billing). If procurement wants PO-driven purchase with net-30, the direct contract route is the fastest.

Proposed next steps from Redwood: 
1) I'll send an NDA for SOC2 access and then share the full report with your security team.
2) Dev to coordinate PO details and provide our standard vendor packet (commercial terms + payment instructions).
3) Oliver to confirm PO sender and target date for approval.

Let me know a few slots for a 20-minute handoff with procurement this week.

Best,
Marissa
(Attachment: Redwood_DPA_v2.pdf)
(Attachment: SOW-draft.docx)

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme procurement & security qualification - internal notes

Marissa / Aisha - quick internal sync on Acme: 

- Procurement wants PO + net-30; marketplace is possible but procurement prefers direct PO. Recommend pushing for marketplace only if it shortens the PO issuance window.

- Terms: try to keep contract close to our standard enterprise terms. If they demand 30+ day payment, we can accept net-30 for this deal but ask for a short-term pilot up front (credit card for first month) to reduce risk.

- Action items: 
  * Marissa - get Oliver's PO template and target approval date.
  * Aisha - please prepare a short vendor packet with payment instructions and standard W-9/COI so procurement has everything they need.
  * I will prepare a one-pager explaining marketplace vs direct PO billing differences for procurement.

Also flagging that if they want the SOC2 full report under NDA, we should use the standard security-sharing NDA and route via legal. I'll stand by for any redlines.

Thanks - Dev
Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
